lines.zh: 我朝你一步一步走过来。
lines.en: I walk toward you step by step.

lines.zh: 地板在我脚下发出响声。
lines.en: The floor creaks under my feet.
I take no detours at all.
I walk straight through that doorway.
My head rises above the doorframe.
I'll still be at the end of the corridor.

lines.zh: 墙上的影子也抬起了手。
lines.en: My shadow on the wall lifts a hand too.
I move forward along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我沿着走廊一直走过去。
lines.en: I keep walking down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了地上的碎瓦片。
lines.en: I crush the broken tiles underfoot.

lines.zh: 我在拐角的地方停一下。
lines.en: I pause at the corner.
You can hear my footsteps.
I stand and watch you, not moving.
My breathing is slow and long.

lines.zh: 我的手指轻轻抖了一下。
lines.en: My fingers twitched a little.
Water drips from the eaves.

lines.zh: 屋子安静得有些不像话。
lines.en: The room has gone unnaturally quiet.

lines.zh: 我歪着头在听你的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head to hear you.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤紧紧贴在骨上。
lines.en: My skin is pulled tight over bone.
My weight has marked the floor.
You can't bear to look, yet you look.
My shadow is much longer than yours.

lines.zh: 我一点呼吸的声音都没有。
lines.en: I make no sound of breathing at all.
I turn my head around slowly.
The door stays open behind you.
You raise your head to look at me.
This is the first time we've spoken.

lines.zh: 你还有别的路可以选吗。
lines.en: Is there any other road for you?
My face is very close to yours.

lines.zh: 你脸上的血色全部退了。
lines.en: All the colour has drained from your face.

lines.zh: 我已经看见了你的眼睛。
lines.en: I have seen your eyes.
You take one small step backwards.
I bear no malice — only necessity.
Your hand fumbles behind your back.
I'll let you lower your hands first.
You look very young.

lines.zh: 你现在可以开口说话了。
lines.en: You may speak now.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有什么误会。
lines.en: There's no misunderstanding between us.

lines.zh: 我的头低到和你一样高。
lines.en: My head comes down level with yours.

lines.zh: 你一直都不肯闭上眼睛。
lines.en: You keep refusing to shut your eyes.
That only makes this take longer.
Don't push yourself to this point.

lines.zh: 你真的已经想清楚了吗。
lines.en: Have you truly thought it through?
My head tilts, then I straighten up.
I stopped and walked on again.
I made no sound whatsoever.
The struck place is very dark.
I bend to examine the wound.
I shifted back a little.
I accept that blow.
My neck clicks once, and that's fixed.
I'm still standing right here.
Put it away; this isn't needed.
These things do nothing for me.
Gripping it tighter changes nothing.

lines.zh: 我知道你只是拖延时间。
lines.en: I know you're only stalling.
You've already tried that several times.
I'm not looking at what you hold.
Your hands are shaking badly.
Put it down and talk properly.
Keeping it means nothing for you.
I don't want any bargain.

lines.zh: 你撞到我身上就被弹开。
lines.en: You hit me and were thrown back.

lines.zh: 我没有后退也没有前进。
lines.en: I neither stepped back nor forward.

lines.zh: 这一下的震动传得很远。
lines.en: The impact carried a long way.
Your back is already against the wall.
I reached out and steadied you.
The two of us are far too close.
Don't crowd in against me.
The floorboards creak under me.
Your breath falls on my hand.
Please take a step backwards.
I want one thing from you.
That isn't what we say to each other.
You and I are both standing here.
We needn't come any closer.
I've been waiting for you a long while.
Are you waiting for me as well?
Our shadows lie side by side.
Standing like this will do.
Nothing more needs saying now.
Let us finish this matter.

lines.zh: 提示音一响，你就该闭眼。
lines.en: When the chime sounds, close your eyes.
This is what you left behind.
It's very light in my hand.
I look at it and set it down.
I don't need to carry it off.

lines.zh: 这样东西本来就属于你。
lines.en: This thing belongs to you anyway.
I set it on the table.
One gentle squeeze flattened it.
You're locked inside this room.
Finding you wasn't difficult.
There's nowhere left for you to go.
The windows are all sealed too.
I'm walking toward you now.
You've backed up beside the cabinet.
Nothing will interrupt this time.
There's no need to shout.
Your road has run out.

lines.zh: 门锁落下的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard the lock fall into place.
I'm three steps away.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的门把手，我摸过了。
lines.en: I have already tried this room's door handle.
Only the last step remains.
This is all about to end.
The hour is now.
I've blocked you at the doorway.
The corner has you held.
I'm shortening the distance step by step.
Your hand is searching for the bolt.
The bolt is locked from outside.
Your heartbeat is deafening.
You've started to tremble.
You have two steps of retreat left.
I paused, then walked on.
The lamp in the room has gone out.
I bend down in front of you.
You've closed your eyes.
Nothing could be better.
Don't open your eyes again.
We've finally come to this.
I've been waiting for you all along.
This is the last moment.
I've pinned your shoulder.
I've caught hold of your hand.
That was done very calmly.
You didn't resist in the least.
I've pressed you against the wall.
You've closed your eyes again.

lines.zh: 我把你轻轻抱起来一点。
lines.en: I lift you gently a little.
I used very little strength.
That will be quite enough.
My hand rests on your forehead.
You're very quiet. That's good.
I set you back down on the floor.

lines.zh: 你的身体已经没有力了。
lines.en: The strength has left your body.
I draw my own hand back.
Everything has grown very light.
I have appeared in this room.
The door has closed behind me.
The lamp in the room just went out.
You turned around and saw me.
I stand much taller than you.
My footsteps are very heavy.
The air turned cold at once.
The floor takes my full weight.
You're still six steps from the door.
I'm blocking the only way out.
We saw each other at the same moment.
I start walking toward your side.
You have only seconds left.
I raise my hand and let it drop.
There's no other sound in the room.

lines.zh: 窗外的天已经完全黑了。
lines.en: The sky outside is fully dark.
My shadow entered the door first.
You heard the hinge give a creak.
You're too late to run now.
The firelight made me step back.
The beams creaked as I fell.
Water poured in and I grew heavy.
The blast pushed me to the wall.
It passed through me with no effect.

lines.zh: 那道光让屋子里更安静了。
lines.en: That light left the room quieter still.

lines.zh: 我已经不需要这些东西。
lines.en: I no longer need such things.

lines.zh: 我下坠时仍是那样平静。
lines.en: I fall as calmly as ever.
